# Purpose

These representative answers assess a hypothetical cylindrical wall and the full circular contact disk. Award correct surface definitions, equilibrium, units, allowable reserve/utilization, and limited conclusions. The seven values are provisional instructional assumptions. Full circular contact, a free lower core face, and sufficient plate/block depth are stipulated; real bending, indentation, contact redistribution, and complete fixture capacity remain unverified. Do not grade the former two-plane area or unsupported strength factors of safety as correct.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

Suggested weighting:

- context interpretation, function, load, and support condition: 15%;
- simplified model and identification of bearing/shear surfaces: 20%;
- bearing and punching shear area identification: 25%;
- average stress calculations: 30%;
- recommendation and missing data: 10%.
